desc:
Welcome to Five TD's! Of course this is the EA Launch of the game so I have SOOO much more planned, including new modes, mini games, animatronics, and way more. First it starts with you guys, show the game some support and share it with your buddies. Join the Discord to keep track of updates and announcements, as well as the ability to report bugs and any suggestions you have. Have Fun!
